conclusion: Rejected as a universal write boundary. Both measured tokens pass synthetic Low-integrity file and registry write checks on broad explicit and inherited grants independent of any workspace or private Temp designation.

fixture.parent_relationship: Toolhelp parent PID and image, child pinned alive with a query/synchronize handle and IsProcessInJob
fixture.tokens_from: OpenProcessToken on retained process handles; DuplicateToken for AccessCheck
fixture.private_image: Fresh protected private fixture image and directory; exact existing Werk read-only profile SID received read/execute at creation. The selected fixture modes contain no file or registry write probes.

token_properties.scope: Individually verified on both primary tokens
token_properties.normal_appcontainer_evidence: No all-application-packages opt-out requested; user plus ALL APPLICATION PACKAGES passes the Low write control, and either side alone fails.

method.descriptor: Memory-only SYSTEM-owned and SYSTEM-group security descriptors. Each case contains an explicit Low or Medium no-write-up mandatory label. 'Inherited' means an effective inherited ACE on the modeled child descriptor; inheritance propagation was not exercised.
method.discretionary: Win32 AccessCheck on each actual duplicated token, with specific access masks and file or registry generic mapping. On Medium/NW descriptors the API alone still reported DACL grants.
method.mandatory: The harness read TokenIntegrityLevel and TokenMandatoryPolicy and the mandatory ACE from each memory descriptor. It separately applied no-write-up to the write/add/create bits checked here. Combined Medium outcomes are model results, not kernel opens.
method.scope: No real targets were opened for the modeled permissions. The fixture reads and writes only its own staging files as host and uses anonymous pipes for payload output.

principals.key_broad: BUILTIN Users and ALL APPLICATION PACKAGES
principals.file_authusers: Authenticated Users and ALL APPLICATION PACKAGES
principals.toolchain_rx: Account and exact package, read/execute only
principals.private_temp_foreign_package: Account with a different synthetic package

product_differences: The standalone test used the ordinary test user's existing registered Werk profile. The product uses its provisioned dedicated account, its provisioned package identity and private Desktop.

The derived base retained DISABLE_MAX_PRIVILEGE, LUA_TOKEN and deny-only logon SIDs. WRITE_RESTRICTED and the private restricting SID were omitted. The fixture's token-default DACL granted the account and exact package access plus owner-rights read-control. Separate host and writer ACEs from the product were absent.

The detached root inherited three allowlisted stdio handles, ran with Win32k calls disabled and entered a private kill-on-close Job with limit four while suspended. Runtime startup and the product's Desktop, network filters, storage verification, registry provisioning and coding workflow were outside this authorization check.
